#         them as null, never 0. A fixture mock serves the SAME numbers on every call, so two
#         samples taken against it differ by nothing and the rates come out 0 bps -- correct
#         arithmetic on constant input, and the reason a real rate is a RED row (DESIGN.md §4b).
# start_time matches get_info.json's start_time (1789518898, uptime 41233 s); the byte counters are
#         the plausible traffic of a synced node over that period (~0.35 MiB/s in).
